manifest.name: dsh-background
manifest.description: Background plugin: durable background image/video preference, General settings row, and document presenter

bundle.text:
# dsh-background bundle patch: mounts the Host gateway; the modules scanner derives
# the browser half from the same entry's dsh.client declaration.
- insert:
    - id: ui-background
      name: 'dsh-background'

readme.text:
[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness plugin: Background plugin. Supports local or online images/videos, and allows adjusting the opacity.

<video src="./1.mp4" controls width="100%"></video>

**Settings UI**

From the Web 插件 (Plugins) settings surface, search this repository and click
install, or from the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:cjz-wr/background-plugin
```

Replace `<name>` with your own profile, usually `web`, for example:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cjz-wr/background-plugin
```

A newly installed bundle layer composes on the next process boot.

> **Build output is committed on purpose.** Git installs pull the repository as
> it is — nothing runs your `build` script. `lib/` is therefore committed so
> git/npm/tarball installs all work with zero build authorization; there is no
> `prepare` script. Rebuild locally with `npm run build` and commit the new
> `lib/` whenever `src/` changes.

> ⚠️ **Conflict only with builds that already compose this row.** The official DeepSeek Harness does NOT ship it — this bundle is a standalone add-on and installs cleanly into any profile. The one exception: this package was extracted from a repo whose `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` already composes a row with the id `ui-background`. Mounting this bundle on top of such a build fails at boot with `duplicate loader entry id: ui-background`; install it into a profile that does not include that built-in row instead.

- `src/` — TypeScript sources (Host gateway + client settings face).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the `dsh.bundle` patch layer (one loader row).
- `lib/` — build output, committed (see note above).
- `node_modules/` — local SDK junction links, git-ignored (not needed by users).

```sh
npm run build
```

Requires the harness toolchain (typescript + tsdown) resolvable at build time;
the extracted folder links the SDK packages it peers on.

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness 插件：背景插件,支持本地或者网络图片/视频，并且支持修改透明度

<video src="./1.mp4" controls width="100%"></video>

**设置界面**

在 Web 插件（插件）设置界面中，搜索此仓库并点击安装，或通过命令行安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:cjz-wr/background-plugin
```

`name` 要根据自行修改，一般为 web,例如

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cjz-wr/background-plugin
```

新安装的 bundle 层将在下一次进程启动时生效。

> **构建输出是有意提交的。** Git 安装会直接拉取仓库原样内容——不会运行你的 `build` 脚本。因此 `lib/` 被提交到仓库中，这样 git/npm/tarball 安装都能在无需构建授权的情况下正常工作；这里没有 `prepare` 脚本。每当 `src/` 发生变化时，请在本地运行 `npm run build` 重新构建并提交新的 `lib/`。

> ⚠️ **仅与已经包含此行的构建冲突。** 官方 DeepSeek Harness 并不包含此功能——本 bundle 是独立的附加组件，可以干净地安装到任何 profile 中。唯一的例外：此包提取自一个 `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` 中已包含 id 为 `ui-background` 的行的仓库。将本 bundle 叠加到此类构建上会在启动时因 `duplicate loader entry id: ui-background` 而失败；请改为安装到不包含该内置行的 profile 中。

- `src/` — TypeScript 源码（Host 网关 + 客户端设置界面）。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — `dsh.bundle` 补丁层（一个 loader 行）。
- `lib/` — 构建输出，已提交（见上方说明）。
- `node_modules/` — 本地 SDK 联接链接，已被 git 忽略（用户无需使用）。

```sh
npm run build
```

需要在构建时能够解析到 harness 工具链（typescript + tsdown）；提取出的文件夹会链接它所依赖的 SDK 包。
